steps.text: Talk to Captain Lawgof near the Coal Truck Mining Site (north of Fishing Guild, West of McGrubor's Wood).
Talk to Captain Lawgof to get more railings.
Inspect the six damaged railings around the camp to fix them.
Talk to Captain Lawgof after repairing the damaged railings.
Go to the top floor of the tower, south of Captain Lawgof, and get the remains there.
Go up the second ladder.
Get the dwarf remains at the top of the tower.
Go down the first ladder.
Go down the second ladder.
Return the remains to Captain Lawgof.
Enter the goblin cave, east of the Fishing Guild entrance.
Search the crates in the north west corner to find Lollk.
Exit the goblin cave and return to Captain Lawgof.
Return to Captain Lawgof.
